name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot Machine Roll
description: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

variables.label: Result
variables.description: Characters the reels land on, one reel column per character. Whitespace is stripped and every reel starts on a zero.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which way the reels roll: up lifts the zero out through the top, down drops it out through the bottom.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Reel height and type size. The roll distance scales with it so the reel always lands exactly one row on.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Character colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
